scenarios.condition: First app launch with no saved places, trips, or progress records
scenarios.expected_behavior: TripsRoot renders calm empty state without flashing or crashing; all flows emit empty lists gracefully

scenarios.condition: Rapid double-click on 'Save Itinerary' button in Planner
scenarios.expected_behavior: Button state transitions to SAVING; idempotent database upsert prevents duplicate entries or primary key crash

scenarios.condition: Malformed completedStopIdsJson string in trip_progress table (e.g., non-JSON or partial write)
scenarios.expected_behavior: parseJsonList / parseJsonIds falls back safely to empty list without unhandled exception

scenarios.condition: User deletes the saved itinerary that is currently marked active
scenarios.expected_behavior: Foreign key cascade atomically deletes trip_progress; UI immediately updates without dangling active state

scenarios.condition: Low disk space condition during save
scenarios.expected_behavior: SQLite / SwiftData throws caught disk error; UI updates saveTripState to SAVE_FAILED without crashing app
